author: Myv
body:
Tarcion, a 4CTW by myself.

Contributors: Zalatoh for helping with the design of mid.

10v10v10v10
Purple, Green, Cyan and Orange
1 wool per team, collect and return a wool from each team to win.
Iron and 1 block of diamond for each team.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/1xTIS
XML and download: soon.

Feel free to leave feedback below.
Thanks,

myv
